name: Wax Cascade
description: The product resting where a vertical cascade of deep jewel-toned molten wax has pooled and begun to set, glossy drips frozen mid-fall around it at varying stages of cooling. Sculptural and vertical, with genuine gloss-to-matte contrast as the wax sets.
lighting: Raking key light, wax gloss-to-matte contrast
subject: product
prompt: the subject resting where a cascade of deep burgundy molten wax has pooled and begun to set, glossy drips frozen mid-fall around it at varying stages of cooling from wet gloss to matte set, a single raking key light tracking the vertical cascade producing genuine specular gloss on still-wet wax and a duller matte sheen where the wax has begun to set, shallow depth of field keeping the subject and immediate wax detail crisp while the wider cascade softens toward the edges of frame, one dominant deep jewel tone throughout with a warm-gold undertone where the wax catches light, no second product, no props beyond the wax, immaculate commercial-render clarity
